name: Okura Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Okura Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells polyethylene and polypropylene products in Japan. It operates through three segments: Synthetic Resin Business, New Material Business, and Construction Materials Business. It offers plastic packaging film for food and other packaging to industrial materials; and Lamitop Masker HR, a masking film used for two-tone color automotive roof. The company also provides thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer film under the Silklon brand name; and solventless acrylic adhesive, including anaerobic adhesives, UV curable adhesive, and two-component curing adhesive under the Yumen Brand name.
